commits.summary: Replay ten merged Java changes at their APIs (verification pending)
commits.body:
Register the thirty M01–M10 predictions and falsifiers as examples 443–452. Use the pin-built artifacts, all four prepared JDKs and the same caller bytecode on each side. The public observations confirmed ten intent changes and ten controls. Three merged challenges exposed the Commons Compress writer preamble offset, Agrona entry hashes and libGDX reused bounds. The Jackson builds share the explicitly reconstructed snapshot inputs.

All ten normal example validators repeated the sixty public JVM histories, including the real Checkstyle CLI and both JDK 8 examples. All 55 selected test suites passed. The two earlier campaign audits retained their totals. Wrong providers, reversed artifact hashes, changed verdicts and an omitted trial were rejected. Job 20261125-220316-replay-all-30-m01-m10-public-predictions repeats the full campaign in an independent export and compares its audit byte for byte.
